value.rationale: Sharp local weak-order loss at low molecule counts is a motivated numerical-method question. The first two relative propensity drops determine whether a binomial corrective step preserves second order, only first order, or fails even first-order consistency. This phase diagram identifies when changing theta helps and when it provably cannot, beyond verification or a routine arithmetic update.
